extDescription.message: Fit a photo or PDF to an upload form's size limit, and turn page images into a PDF. Files never leave your computer.

menuFitForm.message: Fit a file to this form

toastSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save that image. Try another format, or save it to your computer first.

fitButtonTitle.message: Fit a file to this field (iLoathePDF)

toastImageAdded.message: Added to your PDF list ($1 images). Open iLoathePDF from the toolbar to make the PDF.

toastImageBlocked.message: This site doesn't let extensions read that image. Save it to your computer and add it from the iLoathePDF toolbar menu, or allow iLoathePDF on all sites there.

toastImageUnsupported.message: That image can't go into a PDF. JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF and BMP work.

toastPickField.message: Click the Fit button next to the upload field you want.

toastNoFields.message: No upload fields found on this page.

fitTitle.message: Fit a file to this form

fitStandaloneTitle.message: Fit a file to a size limit

noLimitFound.message: No size limit found on the page. Type it in if the form states one.

dropHere.message: Drop a photo or PDF here

keptAsIs.message: Already fits, kept as it is: $1

tooBig.message: Couldn't get under $1. The smallest we could make is $2.

pdfRasterNote.message: PDF pages are re-made as images, so text in the result can't be selected.

firstPageNote.message: Only the first page is used: this field takes one image.

applied.message: Done. The file is in the form.

applyFailed.message: The page didn't take the file. Download it and add it with the page's own button.

errNothingAllowed.message: This field only takes formats iLoathePDF can't make ($1).

errUnsupported.message: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF file. HEIC, SVG and documents aren't supported yet.

errMixed.message: Add either images or PDFs, not both.

errSeveralPdfs.message: This field takes one file. Pick one PDF.

errPassword.message: “$1” is password protected. Unlock it first.

errUnreadable.message: “$1” couldn't be read. It may be damaged.

privacyNote.message: Your files stay on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
